title: App descriptor — app.yaml
description: A machine-readable description of a whole application assembled from the kit: its kind, shell pattern, navigation, and the screens/patterns it composes. The layer above screens — the source of truth for what an app is and how it is wired. The demo console is the first app.yaml.

name.description: kebab slug; must equal the folder name under apps/.

kind.description: The shape of the app the descriptor generates.

shell.description: Name of the layout pattern that frames the app (e.g. `app-shell`).

primaryNav.description: Top-level areas of the app — the primary navigation rail.

sections.description: Grouped secondary navigation — each group holds the routed entries it contains.

screen.description: Optional screen slug (screens/<slug>) this entry renders.

screens.description: Screen slugs (screens/<slug>) this app assembles. Each must exist.

patterns.description: Usage-pattern slugs (patterns/<slug>) this app composes. Each must exist.

tour.description: Identifier of the onboarding tour this app ships (defined in the app).
